phrase.zh: 换一片透镜，看见新的尺度。
phrase.en: A different lens reveals a different scale.

visual.zh: 层层镜片与细线把视线引向画面深处，借光学仪器表达观察如何改变认识。镜片间距与光路是艺术安排，不能据此计算焦距或放大倍数。
visual.en: Layered lenses and fine lines lead the eye into depth, suggesting how instruments change observation. Their spacing and light paths are artistic arrangements, not a measurable optical design.

background.zh: NASA 将折射解释为光从一种介质进入另一种介质时改变传播方向。透镜利用这一性质组织光线；望远镜也可以用反射镜集光。真实仪器的成像取决于材料、曲率和设计，画中的光线并不是实验读数。
background.en: NASA explains refraction as a change in direction when light passes between media. Lenses use this behavior to organize light; telescopes may also collect light with mirrors. Real imaging depends on materials, curvature and design, rather than the decorative paths shown here.
